name: Clackamas Auto Parts
old_description: Proudly serving Oregon City and the surrounding communities since 1934, Clackamas Auto Parts is your locally owned, family-run source for quality automotive parts and trusted machine shop services. Whether you're a DIY enthusiast, professional installer, or part of a commercial fleet, our experienced team is here to help with personalized service, in-depth product knowledge, and an inventory you can count on.
about:
Clackamas Auto Parts has operated from Oregon City, Oregon since 1934. The business remains family-owned and locally run, serving the surrounding communities for nine decades. Founders are not named in available records.

The company combines a retail auto parts operation with an in-house machine shop. The parts inventory covers modern and vintage vehicles, with a focus on hard-to-find components for classic cars. The machine shop provides brake rotor and drum machining, flywheel machining, cylinder head resurfacing and rebuilding, custom engine rebuilding, engine block boring, axle bearing press work, and spray cabinet cleaning. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include DIY enthusiasts, professional installers, and commercial fleets in the Oregon City area. The shop is noted as one of the few remaining in-house automotive machine shops in the region, attracting vintage vehicle owners and local repair shops that need machining services alongside parts supply.

The company emphasizes its knowledgeable staff with decades of experience, personalized service, and the ability to source obsolete vintage parts that are not in stock. These factors, along with the rare combination of retail parts and machine work under one roof, are cited as key differentiators.
